device.basis: GFX 50R 3.11 display control bit-16 handshake polled by 0xcf6adc. A falling request completes after the declared frame period; the delay is not measured.

GFX 50R 3.11 display control bit-16 handshake polled by 0xcf6adc. A falling request completes after the declared frame period; the delay is not measured. GFX 50R 3.11 configuration copy 0xcfc644 writes 0xfff66000, +0x4, +0x20 and +0xc8; the words read back their last write. Routine 0xcfd224 sets bit 28 of +0x2000 (0xfff66000) and polls until it reads clear, the same request as X-T20 2.11 0xca9df0; it is declared to complete at once, not measured. Scanout: emulated GFX 50R 3.11 at 700M instructions holds the X-T20 output 1 layout here: video format 0x333 at +0x010, size 0x3ff02ff (1024 x 768) at +0x02c, buffer +0x030, OSD layer 0 enabled at +0x200 with size +0x220 and buffer +0x230. Captured as host output 0; the period is a declared capture rate, not panel timing.
device.frame_basis: GFX 50R 3.11 timing banks at 0xfff5a000 and 0xfff65000; GIC routes from interrupt table 0xfb93ac rows 0x4c-0x4e and 0x49-0x4b. Frame period 16666 and stop delay 16 are declared guest ticks, not measured camera timing.

device.basis: GFX 50R 3.11 frame sync: the X-T20 law, except bit 0 of +0x00. 0xc8a530 clears it and 0x1a15668 polls it about eleven times through 0xc8a4f8; still clear, it returns 0x86 and 0x1b57db4 restarts the SETUP to REC sequence. The camera reaches REC, so the bit reads set again at once. Not measured: FF80 reads of 0xfff38000 hang the camera (lab/gfx50r-sd-blink/runs/gfx50r-frame-sync-1).
